license_scope.dataset_specific_author_statement: Fin-Fact is released under the MIT License; README explicitly instructs reviewing the license before using the dataset.
license_scope.grant_basis: Dataset-specific README statement plus pinned root LICENSE, beyond a license on scorer code alone.
license_scope.conditions: Retain copyright and permission notice in copies or substantial portions.

official_scorer_static_semantics.input_filter: Every entry with an evidence key; this code alone does not require nonempty evidence, unique IDs, valid classes or a split. Any stricter pilot admission/filter must be explicit and frozen.
official_scorer_static_semantics.premise: Source-order space-join of evidence[*].sentence; no external evidence fetch.
official_scorer_static_semantics.gold: entry.label, original true/false/neutral fact-check labels; no synthetic NLI relabeling by this review.
official_scorer_static_semantics.decision_rule: Strict E>0.5 -> true; otherwise strict N>0.5 -> neutral; otherwise false. This is not multiclass argmax.
official_scorer_static_semantics.metrics: Accuracy, macro precision/recall/F1, confusion matrix and classification report. Proper scores are a new explicit pilot addition.

required_pilot_declarations: Map the actual reader model output labels to canonical E/N/C before applying the official decision rule; microsoft XXL C0/N1/E2 differs from the official ynie example E0/N1/C2.
Freeze exact source/candidate/scorer revisions, label-blind sample identities and role allocation before measurements; no confirmation selection/training.

Declare any context/token limits, empty/malformed evidence handling, argmax, numerical checks and proper-score additions as pilot deviations; do not call them exact original published model/scorer reproduction.
Retrieve only within supplied evidence; a retrieval miss cannot prove neutral or insufficient evidence.
Preserve all sampled failures/truncations and matched same-model retrieval controls, with accuracy/proper scores, timing and resource scope.
